drivingQuestion: Why does the treasurer leave nothing for the debtor's wife and children?
outcomeNote: The exclusion of wife and children is derived from the verse's singular הוא.

segments.he: אֲבָל לֹא לְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּבָנָיו וְכוּ׳. מַאי טַעְמָא? ״הוּא מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ״, וְלֹא אִשְׁתּוֹ וּבָנָיו מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that food and garments are left for him, «but not for his wife or his children.» The Gemara asks: «What is the reason?» The verse states: “If «he be» too poor «for your valuation,”» which indicates that «he» must be sustained «from your valuation, but his wife and his children are not» sustained «from your valuation.»
